verdict.rationale: smolagents supports resuming/stepping through agent runs for tool calls that take days (docs-9) and provides memory/replay and step callbacks (docs-7, docs-8), which enables some long-running execution, but there is no documented scheduler, daemon mode, trigger system, or hosted background runtime for autonomous unattended automations. missing for 10: scheduling/cron support, persistent background execution service, trigger-based automation setup, independent evidence of unattended long-running deployments.
